## Rule

Fill cells strictly between adjacent horizontal marker-pairs (ch1=1 cells) in each row with color 2 (ch2). Background cells (ch0=1) adjacent to markers on BOTH sides get ch2. One-hot encoding: ch0=background, ch1=marker, ch2=fill.

## Algorithm sketch

Single Conv (groups=2, kernel [10,5,1,3], bias [10]):
- ch0 output: center_ch0 - 0.6*left_ch1 - 0.6*right_ch1 → fires at background, suppressed at interior
- ch1 output: identity (center_ch1)
- ch2 output: center_ch0 + left_ch1 + right_ch1 + bias=-2.5 → fires ONLY at interior (all 3 = threshold 2.5)
  - Bias -2.5 prevents boundary leak: padding cells have ch0=0, so they can't exceed threshold

Key insight: The bias threshold (2.5) requires ALL THREE conditions simultaneously: the cell must be active background (ch0=1) AND have a marker to its left (ch1=1) AND a marker to its right (ch1=1). Padding cells fail the center_ch0=1 requirement.

## Cost floor analysis — WALL PROOF (160 is provable floor; source-read 2026-06-12 worker-258)

Grader facts (`neurogolf_utils.py`, read directly):
- `calculate_params` (L309): `params = Σ math.prod(init.dims)` over initializers + Constant `value` tensors. **Element count, dtype-independent** (F16 does NOT help). Conv `pads`/`kernel_shape` are attributes, not initializers → free.
- `calculate_memory` (L194): single node → 0 (input/output excluded, no value_info intermediates).
- `run_network` (L392): output thresholded `(result > 0.0)`. AB/truth gate (`adversarial_against_live.py` L174-178) does `np.array_equal((cand>0),(live>0))` on the **full [1,10,30,30] tensor** → output MUST be 10 channels; a 3-channel output fails array_equal.

Floor derivation (single free-output Conv, the only memory=0 shape-preserving spatial op family):
- Output channels = 10 (forced by tensor-shape equality) → Conv **bias must be [10] = 10 params** (Conv bias = M out-channels, 1-D, non-negotiable).
- Rule needs a 3-wide horizontal window; out-ch2 must read in-ch0 (bg) AND in-ch1 (marker) AND have a constant threshold. So {ch0,ch1,ch2} must lie in the SAME Conv group. groups must divide 10 (∈{1,2,5,10}). A group holding 3 specific channels needs input-group size ≥3 → only groups=1 (size10) or groups=2 (size5) qualify. groups=2 is the larger feasible → smallest weight = **[10,5,1,3] = 150 params**. groups=1 = [10,10,1,3]=300 (worse).
- **Weight 150 + bias 10 = 160 = floor.** Profiled: static=160, profile=160 (`profile_real_cost.py --arcgen 266`).

Ruled-out cheaper routes (cost in params):
- single Conv no-bias (150): §FREE-OUTPUT BOUNDARY LEAK (off-center +taps fire phantoms at the padded boundary) — needs the −2.5 bias to suppress, which costs 10.
- **kw=2 groups=2 (100+10=110)**: EMPIRICALLY 0/266 (worker-258). A 2-tap horizontal window cannot require markers on BOTH the left AND right of center; kw=3 is mandatory.
- **groups=5 (60+10=70)**: EMPIRICALLY 0/266. out-ch2's group ({2,3}→in-ch4,5 or whichever 2-channel block) cannot see in-ch0/in-ch1.
- groups=10 depthwise (30+10=40): out-ch2 sees only in-ch2 (always 0) → impossible.
- ConvTranspose: identical weight shape [10,5,1,3] = same 150+10.
- QLinearConv: weight still 150 elements (params=count, not bytes) PLUS x_scale/x_zp/w_scale/w_zp/y_scale/y_zp/bias initializers → strictly > 160. Dead.
- Gemm/MatMul: require Reshape → multi-node → materializes a [1,10,30,30] (F16=18000B) or [1,1,30,30] BOOL (900B) intermediate, both ≫ 160.
- bias encoded in kernel: impossible without an always-1 input channel (input is one-hot, no constant plane).
- MaxPool @10×10 + Pad ~1828; CumSum span + Pad ~2430 — correct but far above 160.

**Conclusion: 160 is the provable byte-equal floor. No sub-160 route exists.**

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._
- Single Conv without bias: fails §FREE-OUTPUT BOUNDARY LEAK (positive off-center taps fire phantoms outside active grid). The boundary cell (r, W) adjacent to last-column marker (r, W-1) sees ch1_left=1 → ch2 fires incorrectly.
- Multi-node approaches at cost < 160: impossible because intermediate [1,1,30,30] BOOL = 900B alone exceeds 160
- groups=5 Conv: ch2 in group 2 cannot see ch0/ch1 inputs in group 1 — EMPIRICALLY 0/266 (worker-258 2026-06-12)
- kw=2 groups=2 Conv (110 params): EMPIRICALLY 0/266 — a 2-tap window cannot test BOTH left+right markers; kw=3 mandatory (worker-258 2026-06-12)
- QLinearConv: weight still 150 elements (params=count) + 6 quant scalars + bias > 160 — strictly worse (worker-258 2026-06-12)
- CumSum span approach with Pad: minimum ~2430 (much more than 160)
